strategies.name: sma_crossover
strategies.description: Long-only SMA crossover: buy when the fast SMA is above the slow SMA, exit when it falls below.

strategies.name: macd_trend
strategies.description: MACD/EMA trend follower: buy MACD above signal and close above trend EMA; exit when both flip.

strategies.name: donchian_trend
strategies.description: Donchian channel breakout above a trend SMA; exit on a close below the channel low.

strategies.name: turtle_20
strategies.description: Simplified Turtle System 1: N-bar high breakout, shorter low exit, ATR protective stop.

strategies.name: bollinger_breakout
strategies.description: Upper Bollinger band breakout above the Ichimoku cloud; exit below the middle band.

strategies.name: kdj_cross
strategies.description: KDJ momentum: buy when J is above K and D; exit on J turning down, J below K or D, or an ATR stop.

strategies.name: rsi_oversold
strategies.description: RSI oversold dip buying above a trend SMA; exit on RSI recovery or max holding period.

strategies.name: rsi2_connors
strategies.description: RSI(2) oversold dip buying above a long SMA; exit above a short SMA.

strategies.name: ifr2
strategies.description: RSI(2) dip buying above the Ichimoku cloud; exit above the prior two highs.
